title: Settling the Outstanding Agency Service Charge on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
An Air Ticket Fare Brands booking whose lines do not yet cover every traveller it carries has an agency service charge still outstanding. This is the entry point for settling it.

## 1. The situation this governs

The situation is a booking held in one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands on which the agency service charge is not yet covered for all its travellers. The result governed is the sum settled, and the effect is a service line standing on the booking with the booking's net paid total raised by the same sum, so that the booking's travellers are all covered for the service charge.

## 2. Whose settlement it is

It is the traveller's own card that is presented, so the settlement is not made on their behalf. The tool `settle_agency_service_charge_b626effa` is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves.

## 3. Parameters

- `air_booking_id` — the internal reference number of the air booking the service charge is settled against, read from the traveller's booking record returned by the booking lookup. An identifier.
- `customer_id` — the traveller reference number the service line is recorded against, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup. An identifier.
- `service_charge_usd` — the sum settled, in USD with exactly 2 decimal places, stated as a positive number and rounded to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; there is no empty value and no other currency.

## 4. What comes back

A plain-language confirmation line naming the reference of the service line that was posted, the sum settled in USD to two decimal places, and the booking's net paid total once the line landed. The presence of that line reference is what indicates the charge is settled; nothing is returned when no line is posted.
